title: aidd validate --json
description: What `aidd validate --json` prints: whether the files validate, each error, warning, and note, the same as findings, and the next step.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

passed.description: True when there is no error: the exit code is 0.

errors.description: Each error, naming the file it is in (all but a missing config).

warnings.description: Each warning, without its `warning: ` prefix: worth fixing, never failing.

notes.description: Each note, without its `note: ` prefix: an expected state, such as a planned Spec's placeholders, which needs nothing now and never fails.

findings.description: One finding for each error, then each warning, then each note, with the message as its list gives it. A script matches `code` and `severity`, never `message`. A message that opens with the path of a file gives that `path`.

next.description: What to do next. Absent when there is no error.
